strategies.title: Self-enhancement after status loss
strategies.cue: A correction is followed by a sudden insistence on achievements unrelated to the error.
strategies.nearMiss: A comparable surface behaviour may instead be a project lead accurately describing their formal responsibility while also acknowledging other contributors. The learner should check which details genuinely support this item and which remain uncertain.
strategies.response: Ask whether the correction itself was addressed and whether credit is shared accurately.

strategies.title: Narrative ownership after a shared success
strategies.cue: A collaborative result is narrated as one person's defining accomplishment.
strategies.nearMiss: A comparable surface behaviour may instead be a person expressing embarrassment once and later accepting a correction. The learner should check which details genuinely support this item and which remain uncertain.
strategies.response: Compare the story with records of contribution before attributing any motive.

strategies.title: Recognition scarcity framing

strategies.response: Compare attention across ordinary low-status and high-status interactions over time.
